description: Update one of the authenticated worker's own reconciled time-entry cells: set/clear the memo and/or flip the status (EXCLUDED = remove the cell's billing, Upwork "remove time" semantics; BILLABLE = undo a prior exclusion — the reconcile sweep recomputes real billable seconds, so it may land as OVER_LIMIT). Refused for cells on an approved/locked/invoiced week and for buyer-DISPUTED cells. Requires time:write scope and the public API time-tracking feature.

entryId.description: The reconciled time-entry (cell) id to update.

memo.description: New memo for the cell; empty/null clears it. Omit to leave unchanged.

note.description: Dispute note — required when a buyer sets DISPUTED.

status.description: Worker: EXCLUDED removes the cell's billing ("remove time"); BILLABLE undoes a prior exclusion. Buyer (contract hirer): DISPUTED flags the cell (note required); BILLABLE removes the flag. Recomputed by the reconcile sweep. Omit to leave unchanged.

name: opentrain_time_entry_update
